subject: Access & provisioning clarifications for Archon Energy RFP
messages:
From: Jenna Parker <j.parker@archonenergy.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@archonenergy.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Clarifications on SSO / provisioning for RFP (Archon Energy)

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the RFx packet — our security and cloud teams are reviewing. A few follow-ups from the provisioning section where we need short, explicit answers so we can include them in the vendor comparison: 

1) SCIM provisioning: do you support incremental (delta) syncs and how do you handle attribute transformations (e.g., group membership -> role claim)?
2) Account linking: if a user signs up via email and later we provision via SCIM, how is dedupe/linking handled? Can we enforce SSO-only accounts?
3) SSO: support for both SAML and OIDC? Do you provide IdP-initiated login and SP-initiated? Any constraints on assertion size/attributes?
4) RBAC / admin separation: do you provide a built-in admin roles matrix and least-privilege templates?
5) Audit logs / retention: do you expose immutable audit events for account create/update/delete and who performed the change? Retention options?

We have a tight procurement window; short, concrete bullets work best (we may paste verbatim). Also would like any diagrams or matrices as attachments for the security pack.

Best,
Jenna
Jenna Parker
Senior Security Architect
Archon Energy

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Clarifications on SSO / provisioning for RFP (Archon Energy)

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary answers below; attaching a SCIM sync diagram and our admin roles matrix for the security pack. Where you want a one-line answer I put it first. If you need wording edited for the RFP PDF, tell me and we'll send a cut-and-paste version.

1) SCIM provisioning: yes — delta syncs supported.
   - One-line: SCIM 2.0 API with full support for incremental (delta) syncs and pagination.
   - Details: our SCIM implementation exposes /Users and /Groups with support for startIndex/count pagination and supports incremental changes via lastModified and changeType. For large directories we recommend delta-based polling (we support ifModifiedSince and change tokens tied to our connector). Attribute transforms can be defined in our provisioning policy UI: e.g., map group "ops-admins" -> assign role "ops_admin" in Redwood. Transformations are applied server-side at provisioning time; we store the canonical mapping in the team config so audits show original group -> mapped role.

2) Account linking / SSO-only enforcement: yes.
   - One-line: account linking by email is supported and SSO-only enforcement is configurable per-organization.
   - Details: we do a best-effort deterministic match on lowercased email address and SCIM externalId (if provided). If a conflict is detected (existing local account with same email), we mark it as 'requires owner approval' by default; customers can change this to automatic link or to create duplicate account prevention with automatic deactivation. For SSO-only enforcement, org admins can require IdP authentication for login; local password auth is disabled for accounts flagged as SSO-managed.

3) SSO (SAML/OIDC): both supported.
   - One-line: SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) supported, both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
   - Details: SAML: metadata upload or IDP-initiated URL; we support attribute mapping of SAML assertions to profile fields and role claims. Max assertion size: we recommend < 256KB payloads; very large embedded attributes should be avoided (we'll strip unsupported attributes). OIDC: standard OIDC flows with support for custom claims mapping. We accept group/role claims in JWTs and can map them to internal RBAC.

4) RBAC / admin separation: built-in templates available.
   - One-line: role-based access with configurable roles and prebuilt least-privilege templates for Platform Admin, Billing Admin, Support Engineer, and Read-Only Auditor.
   - Details: Admin roles are hierarchical; permissions are fine-grained (create/deploy/model/manage-billing/view-logs). Roles can be restricted to specific projects/environments and bound to SCIM groups for automatic role assignment. We support approval workflows for granting elevated roles and time-limited role grants.

5) Audit logs / retention: yes, immutable events with configurable retention.
   - One-line: immutable audit trail for user lifecycle and admin actions; retention configurable 90/365/730 days and exportable to customer S3 or SIEM.
   - Details: every create/update/delete on user, group, role, and authentication event is recorded with actor, timestamp, and before/after deltas. Logs are tamper-evident (SHA256 chain) and can be forwarded in real-time via Kafka or stored to your S3 bucket.

Attachments: redwood-scim-sync-diagram-v1.pdf (diagram of delta and full-sync flows), redwood-admin-roles-matrix.xlsx (CSV/XLSX), redwood-sso-implementation-notes.txt (practical checklist).

If useful I can have Karthik drop a short note on connector performance for large directories (we've tested 500k users with incremental syncs).

Best,
Logan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarifications on SSO / provisioning for RFP (Archon Energy) — connector and delta behavior

Hi Jenna — Karthik here (Identity Engineering). Adding a couple technical notes you might paste into a security appendix: 

- Delta semantics: our connector issues a change token after each successful delta run. Delta runs return all changes (add/update/delete) since the last token. We also provide a conflict list when a delta contains a change that cannot be applied automatically (e.g., duplicate emails across tenants).
- Attribute transformations: transformations are executed in a sandbox pipeline; original incoming attributes are logged (redacted if PII) alongside the mapped values so you can audit the mapping. Mapping rules are versioned; rollbacks are supported.
- SCIM provisioning performance: tested 10k changes/min on medium connectors (g4-equivalent); performance scales linearly with connector workers and we provide tuning knobs.
- Account linking edge cases: if SCIM externalId is provided by your IdP we prioritize externalId over email for link/dedupe. If you want to enforce SSO-only and prevent local signups, set "enforce_idp_only": true in the org policy or toggle in console; we can send an IaC sample for your infra team.

If you want sample curl/terraform snippets for the connector config I can attach them.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer, Identity
Redwood Inference
